# Concentric Frame

> A layout frame for React and shadcn that keeps nested corner radii concentric through CSS variables.

- Docs and live demo: https://eased.dev/components/concentric-frame?ref=context7
- Source: [src/registry/eased/concentric-frame/](../../src/registry/eased/concentric-frame/)
- Installs: `components/eased/concentric-frame/concentric-frame.tsx`

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn add @eased/concentric-frame
```

Or by URL:

```bash
npx shadcn add https://eased.dev/r/concentric-frame.json
```

Import paths below assume the default `@/components` alias in `components.json`.

## Usage

Import Frame, FrameInner and useFrame from components/eased/concentric-frame/concentric-frame. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
